entries.text: 小生乃橘子學院美術老師……\n寶可夢聯盟四天王，名為八朔。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_first_00

entries.text: 小生乃葡萄學院美術老師……\n寶可夢聯盟四天王，名為八朔。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_first_00b

entries.text: 藍莓學園的各位同學，\n請多指教是也。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_first_01

entries.text: 哎呀，原來是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學\n邀請小生過來的啊。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_00

entries.text: 才一段時日不見，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就已能挑起這樣的重責大任……！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_01

entries.text: 小、小生……森森驚訝與感動，\n真是無比感慨得……[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_02

entries.text: 別哭！
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 八朔老師！！
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_select_02

entries.text: ……簡直就要掉眼淚了，\n但小生會咬牙忍住的是也。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_03

entries.text: 畢竟這樣是會嚇到\n學園的各位同學的啊。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_04

entries.text: 沒想到小生竟然能獲得\n在他校執教鞭的機會，\r\n真是叫人開心。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_00

entries.text: 對了，身為美術老師的小生\n以及身為四天王的小生……\r\n這所學園期望的是哪個身分的小生呢？[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_01

entries.text: 美術老師！
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 四天王！
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_select_02

entries.text:
真是那樣的話就好了。
畢竟之前小生上了美術課時，
同學們的反應不甚理想……
是小生想太多了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_02

entries.text: 果然是那樣啊！\c\n畢竟之前小生上了美術課時，\n同學們的反應不甚理想……[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_02b

entries.text: 這麼說來，小生聽說過\n藍莓學園很注重寶可夢對戰。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_03

entries.text: 那麼下堂課就請圓陸鯊前輩\n來為同學們上一堂實習課吧。\r\n感謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的建言是也！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_04

entries.text: 聽說在藍莓學園，\n學生都是自動自發地參與著\r\n委員會和學園的營運啊！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_00

entries.text: 不愧是新的學園，\n充滿了挑戰精神呢。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_01

entries.text:
話雖如此，從年少之時
就必須要扛起責任……\c
小生個人對此事的看法
是多少有所保留的。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_02

entries.text: 為什麼呢？
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 也就是說……？
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 畢竟，盡情玩耍不需負任何責任，\n這是小孩子才能擁有的特權啊。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_03

entries.text: 就這個層面來說，\n小生也很擔心[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_04

entries.text: 請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳千萬要小心，\n不要過度背負他人的期待喔。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_00

entries.text: 失禮了……上了年紀後，\n說話總是會像是在說教。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_01

entries.text: 好，讓我們換個心情！\n和小生交換寶可夢如何？[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_02

entries.text: 真心地感謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是也。\n小生打算拿精挑細選過的凍脊龍來交換，\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳呢？[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊……
很有[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的風格呢。\c
今後就讓小生來
無微不至的培育牠吧。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_04

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_02_03

entries.text:
如果只有１隻寶可夢，
是難以交換的。\c
帶著２隻以上的同行寶可夢再來吧。
請多指教是也。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_03_00

entries.text: 等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想要交換了，\n再請多指教是也。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_03_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳願意和小生\n交換寶可夢了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_04_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學，\n若是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳願意的話，\r\n和小生來場對戰如何？[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_talkto_00

entries.text: 那麼下次有機會時，\n就再請多指教是也。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_cancel_00

entries.text: 現在就讓我親身感受\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有何等強大吧。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 54]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battlestart_01

entries.text: ……在聯盟交手之時，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的實力還不夠成熟，\r\n但蘊含著尚未完成的強大。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 而那份實力在今日卻是\n如此地……堅不可摧……[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 小生……無比感慨……\n嗚哦喔喔～哦喔喔！！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 請今後也繼續保持謙虛，\n自由地在[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的路途上勇往直前。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]以八朔老師為靈感，\n想出了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]無比感慨表情[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_reward_00

entries.text: 謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳與小生交手。\c\n請讓小生頒授巨龍獎\n給奮力對戰的[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳吧。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 如果[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳覺得能從小生身上學到些什麼，\n就讓我們下次再來交手吧。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 這次就由小生摘下勝利了。\c\n但就剛才的對戰過程來看……\n下次的結果就不得而知了。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: 看著每次見面都比上一次\n有所成長的[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，小生就……\r\n不由自主地熱淚盈眶啊。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 藍莓學園的學生\n也都是一群好孩子呢。\r\n教起來非常有成就感是也。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
小生曾經在釀光市的
大螢幕上看到阿寇。\c
見到朋友努力的樣子，
會令人感到非常喜悅呢。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳交換給我的\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)]是個很棒的孩子呢。\c\n牠會主動來當小生作畫時的模特兒。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_03

entries.text: 凍脊龍過得還好嗎？\c\n牠很喜歡被摸肚子，\n偶爾幫牠搓搓揉揉，牠會很開心的。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_04
